mapper.select: SELECT id, enterprise_code, tenant_code, company_name, industry, scale, license_no, register_address, legal_person, license_file_id, contact_name, contact_phone, contact_email, status, create_time, update_time, creator, editor, is_deleted FROM enterprise WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND creator = #{applicantId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT enterprise_code FROM enterprise WHERE enterprise_code LIKE CONCAT(#{datePrefix}, '%') ORDER BY enterprise_code DESC LIMIT 1
